name: water filter swap
summary: Replace the filter cartridge in a water jug.

steps.description: Lift the old filter cartridge out of the jug.
Press the new filter cartridge into the jug until it clicks.
steps.teacher_caption: A white filter cartridge seated in the funnel of a water jug.
expected_requirements: New cartridge seated in the funnel

key_info.action: press the cartridge into the funnel
key_info.target_state: cartridge seated flush in the funnel

steps.description: Put the lid back on the jug.
